Floats: nav on the left, aside on the right, text wrapping in between

Left float: 150px

Right float: 160px

The paragraph inside the flow wraps around both floats: its line boxes are shortened on the left by the navigation column and on the right by the aside, and get their full width back below them.

Floats leave the normal flow, so the surrounding blocks overlap them while only the line boxes move aside. The footer clears both, which is the classic way to end a float layout.

Footer with clear: both
